test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : EPV :: RFS : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : EPV :: RFS : % 

Option 1) # = DNU, % = SHT → DNU : EPV :: RFS : SHT 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/704b0e8a48c338e7ee3889e308374d8c54df61268038f3601fb322bbee0d8b6b.png] 

Option 2) # = CNU, % = THV → CNU : EPV :: RFS : THV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad4d2afd13b1dbc8615e0578c40eecc865978a68fdee5d429707b2291176dee4.png] 

Option 3) # = COW, % = SGQ → COW : EPV :: RFS : SGQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/132b9c35f316bc290874ce425eb3e28f0c8ca2ea7d6d827af1d908c7e3645b57.png] 

Option 4) # = DMU, % = SGL → DMU : EPV :: RFS : SGL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4c3b95f11c22cf26d7a021f29e92a42daf89bb06c9e09801bab37c7caddea0b.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
